row_tip_cpu_min_ac: Minimum processor state percentage when idle
row_tip_cpu_max_ac: Maximum processor state percentage (setting 99% disables Turbo Boost)
row_tip_cpu_max_freq_ac: Processor maximum clock frequency cap in MHz (0 = Uncapped / Hardware Limit)
row_tip_energy_perf_pref_ac: Processor Energy Performance Preference balance (0=Max Performance, 100=Max Energy Saving)
row_tip_boost_mode_ac: Processor clock boost policy algorithm (Aggressive, Enabled, etc.)
row_tip_cooling_policy_ac: Active: Increases fan speed before throttling; Passive: Slows processor before increasing fan speed
row_tip_core_parking_min_ac: Minimum percentage of unparked (always active) CPU cores
row_tip_core_parking_max_ac: Maximum percentage of CPU cores allowed to park into sleep state (100% = All parkable)
row_tip_pcie_aspm_ac: PCI Express Link State Power Management (ASPM) latency mode for GPU and NVMe SSDs
row_tip_usb_suspend_ac: USB selective suspend power-saving for idle ports
row_tip_wifi_power_saving_ac: Wireless adapter power saving mode ('Maximum Performance' recommended for gaming ping)
row_tip_video_timeout_ac: Idle timeout before monitor turns off automatically
row_tip_sleep_timeout_ac: Idle timeout before computer enters sleep mode
row_tip_hybrid_sleep_ac: Writes RAM state to disk during sleep to prevent data loss in sudden power outages
row_tip_hibernate_timeout_ac: Idle timeout before saving session to disk and shutting down completely (0 = Never)
row_tip_allow_wake_timers_ac: Allows Windows Task Scheduler or wake timers to wake computer from sleep
row_tip_power_button_ac: Action to take when chassis hardware power button is pressed
row_tip_sleep_button_ac: Action to take when keyboard sleep button is pressed
row_tip_disk_timeout_ac: Idle timeout before spinning down mechanical hard drive motors

boost_opt_0: 0: Disabled / Off (Prevents heat and fan noise)
cooling_opt_1: 1: Active (Increase fan speed before throttling - Recommended)
cooling_opt_0: 0: Passive (Throttle processor clock instead of fans)
hybrid_opt_0: 0: Off (Classic Fast Sleep - No disk writes)
hybrid_opt_1: 1: Enabled / On (Save RAM to disk - Protected against outages)
wake_opt_0: 0: Disabled (PC will never wake on its own)
wake_opt_1: 1: Enabled (Task Scheduler and programs can wake PC)
wake_opt_2: 2: Important Wake Timers Only (Critical system events)
